coordinate_mapping.target_coordinate_space: VirEnv prefab-local XZ; vertical Y not derived
coordinate_mapping.method: Map2D.Run obtains the 2D root Renderer.bounds; Map2D maps x/y fractions affinely to TerrainData size.x/size.z and adds the Terrain transform position.
coordinate_mapping.limitations: The static mapping establishes horizontal placement only. Terrain height, bridge deck occupancy, and navigable continuity at each crossing are not derivable from the Phase 8 event row or a serialized road-object hierarchy.

hierarchy: source proof of a common road plane with no relevant grade separation
manual Unity visual and movement inspection
available: five serialized MeshCollider bridge objects in each environment
insufficient_for_final_decision: roads are encoded as terrain alphamap texture, not semantic road meshes
no road connectivity graph or road-specific nav surface is present
bridge generation uses endpoint chords rather than lossless quadratic curves
evidence_policy.static_classification_result: Static repository evidence was insufficient for all 48 events; direct manual Unity inspection was required.
evidence_policy.final_classification_result: All 48 events are connected_same_level based on completed direct researcher inspection of the 3D Unity environments.

manual_review_method: direct researcher inspection of the 3D Unity environments
bridge_evidence_clarification: Static inspection found five collider-backed bridges in each environment but could not reliably associate them with Phase 8 crossing events. Subsequent direct manual Unity inspection confirmed that none of the 48 reviewed road-road crossings is road-over-road or road-under-road grade-separated.

review_location_grouping.policy: Only numerically equivalent Phase 8 mathematical coordinates may share an ID; no snapping or near-coordinate merge is permitted.
review_location_grouping.result: all 48 coordinates are distinct under the Phase 8 numerical policy
